Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology
Two specialized programs in medical laboratories, radiology, and medical imaging
The faculty offers two applied academic pathways focused on preparing qualified professionals to work in medical laboratories and radiology and medical imaging units through scientific study and practical training aligned with the needs of the healthcare labor market.
Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology
The Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology at East Port Said National University prepares scientifically and practically distinguished specialists in modern health technology fields through applied academic programs that combine scientific knowledge with practical training in laboratories and healthcare institutions.
Applied Educational Vision
The faculty focuses on developing graduates with professional skills capable of supporting the healthcare system while adhering to quality standards, occupational safety, and healthcare ethics.
Programs on This Page
- Medical Laboratory Technology Program.
- Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology Program.
- Study is conducted in English over 131 credit hours.
Program Director
Prof. Dr. Salma Mostafa Khairallah
Program Director of the Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology. She holds a PhD in Biochemistry from the Faculty of Science at Port Said University and previously served as Director of the Biochemistry and Microbiology Program at the Faculty of Science, Port Said University.
Programs Available at the Faculty
This page presents only the Medical Laboratory Technology Program and the Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology Program according to the data provided in the academic program file.
Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology
Medical imaging technologies and radiation safety.
Program Details
Medical Laboratory Technology Program
About the Program
The Medical Laboratory Technology Program is one of the programs of the Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology. It aims to prepare qualified healthcare professionals with the scientific knowledge and practical skills required to work in medical analyses and modern laboratory technologies.
The program focuses on studying basic and medical sciences related to laboratories, such as hematology, biochemistry, microbiology, parasitology, immunology, and laboratory diagnostic techniques, with emphasis on practical training in specialized laboratories and healthcare institutions.
The program seeks to graduate specialists capable of conducting medical tests and analyses accurately and efficiently, using modern laboratory devices and technologies, and adhering to quality standards, occupational safety, and healthcare ethics to meet labor market needs in the medical sector.
Program Objectives
- Preparing qualified graduates with the scientific knowledge and applied skills required to work efficiently in medical laboratories.
- Providing students with modern scientific foundations in different fields of medical analysis, such as hematology, biochemistry, microbiology, parasitology, and immunology.
- Developing students’ skills in using modern laboratory devices and technologies and conducting laboratory tests according to quality and accuracy standards.
- Qualifying students to apply biosafety procedures and quality practices in medical laboratories.
- Developing students’ ability to analyze and interpret laboratory test results and contribute to supporting medical diagnosis.
- Enhancing scientific research and lifelong learning skills to keep pace with developments in health sciences and medical technology.
- Preparing professionals capable of competing in the healthcare labor market and contributing effectively to the development of healthcare services.
Learning Outcomes
By the end of the program, graduates will be able to:
- Understand the fundamentals of medical laboratory sciences and different fields of analysis.
- Prepare and process medical samples according to professional standards.
- Perform hematology, biochemistry, microbiology, parasitology, and immunology tests.
- Operate medical laboratory equipment and perform basic routine maintenance.
- Apply quality, occupational safety, and infection control procedures.
- Analyze laboratory test results and prepare laboratory reports.
Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology Program
About the Program
The Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology Program aims to prepare technology specialists capable of operating modern medical imaging technologies to assist in diagnosing medical conditions.
The program focuses on practical training using different radiology devices, while applying radiation protection and safety rules and building scientific knowledge related to diagnostic and therapeutic imaging technologies.
The program qualifies graduates to work efficiently within the healthcare team, operate various medical imaging devices safely and effectively, prepare patients for examination procedures, and adhere to quality standards in radiology units.
Program Objectives
- Preparing specialists in radiologic technology and medical imaging.
- Providing students with scientific knowledge of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging technologies.
- Training students to operate X-ray, CT, and MRI equipment.
- Enhancing skills in applying radiation protection and occupational safety rules.
- Qualifying graduates to work efficiently within the healthcare team.
Learning Outcomes
By the end of the program, graduates will be able to:
- Understanding the scientific and physical principles related to radiology and medical imaging.
- Operating different medical imaging devices efficiently and safely.
- Preparing patients for radiological examination procedures.
- Applying radiation protection rules and reducing occupational risks.
- Evaluating radiological image quality in coordination with the specialist physician.
- Adhering to quality and accreditation standards within radiology units.
Laboratories and Equipment
The program provides an educational and laboratory environment that supports the acquisition of theoretical knowledge and practical skills required by the healthcare labor market.
Specialized Laboratories
The program includes specialized teaching laboratories to train students in practical and applied aspects of health sciences technology, including medical laboratory labs equipped with the tools needed for training in different medical analyses.
Devices and Technologies
Students train in microscopy, biochemistry, fundamentals of hematology, and microbiology, in addition to training related to operating X-ray, CT, and MRI devices in the Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology Program.
Training Environment
The program provides equipped classrooms, e-learning tools, and digital learning resources, helping students acquire theoretical knowledge and connect it with practical application.
Practical Skills
Training focuses on conducting laboratory tests, preparing samples, operating equipment efficiently and safely, preparing patients for radiological examination procedures, and applying quality and occupational safety standards.
Academic and Training Partnerships
The program is linked to several cooperation protocols with specialized healthcare institutions to provide clinical training and practical application opportunities for students, connecting the academic component with real practice in different healthcare environments.
Port Said University Hospital
Ahl Masr Hospital
Al Nas Hospital
Saudi German Hospital
Children’s Cancer Hospital Egypt 57357
Plasma Donation Centers
These partnerships contribute to developing students’ practical skills, introducing them to modern work methods within healthcare institutions, and improving their readiness for the labor market through training in specialized medical environments.
Career Opportunities
The two programs provide students with a clear professional pathway within the healthcare sector by combining academic knowledge with practical training on the technologies and devices used in medical laboratories and medical imaging units.
Medical Laboratory Technology
The program qualifies graduates to work efficiently in medical laboratory environments through skills in sample preparation and processing, conducting laboratory analyses, operating equipment, and adhering to quality, safety, and infection control standards.
- Medical Laboratory Technology Specialist.
- Medical analysis laboratories.
- Laboratory departments in hospitals.
- Quality, safety, and infection control units.
- Laboratory testing environments under the supervision of the specialized medical team.
Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology
The program qualifies graduates to use and operate medical imaging equipment, apply radiation protection rules, prepare patients for examinations, and work according to quality and accreditation standards in healthcare environments.
- Radiologic and Medical Imaging Technology Specialist.
- Diagnostic and therapeutic radiology units.
- X-ray units.
- CT units.
- MRI units.
- Medical imaging centers.
Professional Readiness
The two programs focus on preparing graduates capable of working within integrated healthcare teams while adhering to professional standards, healthcare ethics, and occupational safety.
Key Areas of Excellence
Modern and Specialized Programs
Academic programs aligned with global developments in health technology fields and labor market needs.
Integrating Theory with Practice
The study combines scientific knowledge with intensive practical training to prepare graduates with the required professional skills.
Specialized Laboratories and Equipment
An educational environment and specialized laboratories equipped with modern technologies and devices used in health fields.
An interdisciplinary program combining geospatial sciences, geographic information systems, remote sensing, and data analysis using artificial intelligence technologies.
Cooperation protocols with specialized healthcare institutions and medical centers to provide clinical training opportunities.
Quality and Occupational Safety
Preparing graduates capable of using modern medical technologies and devices while adhering to quality and occupational safety standards.
Research and Lifelong Learning
Developing scientific research and lifelong learning skills to keep pace with advances in healthcare and medical technology.
Healthcare Teamwork
Qualifying students to work efficiently and professionally within integrated healthcare teams.
Competitiveness
Enhancing graduates’ ability to compete in the local and regional labor market.

title: University Life
text:
إنجازات طلابية
Student Success Stories
نماذج متميزة من طلاب جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية حققوا إنجازات في المجالات الفنية والثقافية والعلمية والرياضية.
First Place
Hana Naeem
Faculty of Medicine
الحاصلة على المركز الأول في الغناء بمسابقة «بورسعيد أرض المواهب»
«كانت جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية نقطة البداية لاكتشاف موهبتي، فقد أتاحت لي الفرصة للمشاركة في المسابقة، ووجدت من إدارة رعاية الطلاب دعمًا ومتابعة مستمرة في جميع المراحل حتى حققت المركز الأول. هذه التجربة زادت ثقتي بنفسي وأكدت لي أن الجامعة تؤمن بقدرات طلابها وتحرص على تنمية مواهبهم.»
Finalist
ريماس أيمن حامد عبد الغني
Faculty of Pharmacy
المتأهلة للتصفيات النهائية لمهرجان إبداع في مجال الفنون التشكيلية
«كان الدعم الذي وجدته من إدارة رعاية الطلاب دافعًا حقيقيًا للاستمرار والتميز. لم يقتصر دورهم على تشجيعي، بل كانوا بجانبي في كل خطوة، وهو ما منحني الثقة للوصول إلى التصفيات النهائية لمهرجان إبداع.»
Third Place
خالد وليد رفعت
Faculty of Pharmacy
الحاصل على المركز الثالث في بطولة جامعة سيناء لكرة السلة
«أعتز بانتمائي لجامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية، فقد وجدت دعمًا كبيرًا من إدارة رعاية الطلاب التي وفرت لنا كل ما نحتاجه للمشاركة في البطولات. هذا الاهتمام كان سببًا رئيسيًا في تحقيق نتائج نفخر بها.»
Third Place
Karim Mahmoud Khattab
Faculty of Engineering
الفائز بالمركز الثالث في مهرجان إبداع بمشروع الذكاء الاصطناعي
«إيمان الجامعة بأفكارنا وتشجيع أعضاء هيئة التدريس وإدارة رعاية الطلاب كان الدافع الأكبر لتحويل فكرتنا إلى إنجاز. أفخر بتمثيل جامعتي، وأتطلع إلى تحقيق المزيد من النجاحات باسمها.»
Finalist
إبراهيم محمد إبراهيم يوسف
Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology
المتأهل للتصفيات النهائية في مجال الإنشاد الفردي
«وجدت في جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية بيئة تشجع على اكتشاف المواهب وتنميتها. دعم إدارة رعاية الطلاب منحني الفرصة لتطوير موهبتي والوصول إلى التصفيات النهائية، وهو ما يدفعني للاستمرار وتحقيق إنجازات أكبر.»
Third Place
مريم محمود خليفة
Faculty of Engineering
الفائزة بالمركز الثالث في مهرجان إبداع
«إتاحة الفرصة للمشاركة في مهرجان إبداع والدعم المستمر الذي قدمته الجامعة كانا وراء هذا الإنجاز. كانت تجربة ثرية عززت شغفي بالابتكار، وأطمح إلى تمثيل الجامعة في المزيد من المحافل العلمية.»
Third Place
مريم بكر علي صالح
Faculty of Medicine
الحاصلة على المركز الثالث في بطولة جامعة سيناء
«كان دعم الجامعة وإدارة رعاية الطلاب عاملًا أساسيًا في مشاركتي وتحقيق هذا الإنجاز. أشعر بالفخر لتمثيل جامعتي، وأسعى دائمًا إلى تحقيق المزيد من النجاحات التي ترفع اسمها.»
Third Place
Aya Mohamed Hosny Khafagy
Faculty of Engineering
الفائزة بالمركز الثالث في مهرجان إبداع
«حظيت منذ البداية بدعم وتشجيع كبير من إدارة الجامعة وإدارة رعاية الطلاب وأعضاء هيئة التدريس، وهو ما منحني الثقة للاستمرار وتحقيق هذا الإنجاز. أشعر بالفخر لانتمائي إلى جامعة تؤمن بطلابها وتدعم طموحاتهم.»
Third Place
حبيبة عراقي عبد الوكيل
Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology
الحاصلة على المركز الثالث في بطولة جامعة سيناء
«وفرت لي الجامعة كل سبل الدعم للمشاركة في البطولة، وساعدتني إدارة رعاية الطلاب في تهيئة الظروف المناسبة للتركيز وتحقيق أفضل أداء. هذا الدعم كان له أثر كبير في الوصول إلى منصة التتويج.»

title: University President’s Message
text:
University President’s Message
University President’s Message
السيد الأستاذ الدكتور/ عاطف علم الدين
منذ بداية عهد فخامة الرئيس عبد الفتاح السيسي في عام 2014 والذي دشن إعلان الجمهورية الجديدة، تم وضع استراتيجية تطويرية للتعليم الجامعي تتوافق مع رؤية مصر 2030، وقد هدفت تلك الإستراتيجية إلى إنشاء عدد من الجامعات الأهلية الغير هادفة للربح لتغطي كافة ربوع مصر من ناحية، ولتواكب الزيادة المضطردة في عدد السكان وتحقيق رغبة الطلاب فى اكتساب المهارات التخصصية المطلوبة لسوق العمل. ومن بين تلك الجامعات التي تم انشاءها، جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية والتي أقيمت على بقعة عزيزة من تراب مصر وهي سيناء الحبيبة لتكون تلك الجامعة بمشيئة الله تعالى هي قاطرة التنمية في منطقة شرق بورسعيد، تلك المنطقة التي تحمل عبقرية المكان بكل ما تحمله من معنى. إن هذه الأرض البِكر لن ينميها إلا شباب مصر الأوفياء الذين شَرُفت أسرة جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية بإنضمامهم إليها حيث تسعى إدارة الجامعة إلى اكسابهم المعارف والمهارات المطلوبة كل في تخصصه من خلال مجموعة من البرامج الأكاديمية المتميزة والتى تحقق متطلبات سوق العمل، كما تولى الجامعة الإهتمام بالبحث العلمى والعمل على تنمية المجتمع أيضا وتقوم الجامعة ومن خلال أنشطتها المتنوعة بإكتشاف مواهب طلابها وصقل مهاراتهم وتنمية قدراتهم سعيًا منها لخلق مستقبل مشرق لمصرنا الحبيبة. وفقنا الله لخدمة وطننا الغالى.
